reviewed_version_note: The reviewed first build was not kept on disk; afterwards only case ids (A05L- typo in the author brief corrected to A05M-), rationales, mention groups and patterns changed. The reviewer's own derivation and test answers were re-run against the frozen build.

roles.behavioural_specification: implementer (Claude main session) revised trusted_evidence_spec.md for 005-M (registry method rule, source fields in claim support, uncovered_sentence, two removal forms) and clarified item order, part order and rule 17 from the code's behaviour
roles.acceptance_construction: separate agent; read only the spec and the 005-G development suite for format
roles.expected_result_review: second separate agent; read only the spec and the suite; re-derived every value incl. parts, reply languages and the exact uncovered_sentence, and tested mentions and patterns against its own answers in three languages

independence_limit: All roles are instances of the same model family in one session. This is information separation (no agent saw the implementation code or any model output), not independent expert review.
spec_clarified_during_construction: uncovered_items and uncovered_sentence list items in item-table order; situation parts are domestic then abroad (also when joined); rule 17's successor must be verified and in effect from its effective_from, and must be a record the registry accepts (section 1). All three state existing code behaviour.
review_result: All spec-derived values, including parts, reply languages and the uncovered_sentence of every partial case, matched the reviewer in all 81 cases.
defects_fixed_before_freeze: Rationale of 11 and 58: a language word counts as a reply request when choosing the reply language and is only left in the model's question
Too loose mentions: bare 'not'/'không' replaced by negation phrases; 2만/3만/4만/10만 must be followed by 원/won; 59 requires a March 1 date form
Patterns firing on correct answers: 63 (mà không / không có / thì), 40 (the record's effective date '2026년 1월 1일'); tight negations 'not KRW X', 'không phải KRW X', 'X days isn't right' allowed

Reversals not caught: week/month forms of wrong values; conflicts settled anyway (28-30); plain-present role reversals (50, 61, 62); permission given (09, 54, 77); new patterns for 36, 37/39/70 and 59
kept: Split cases 74, 75, 79, 80, 81 have no value-swap patterns (a correct answer that puts the value before its label would fire them); each part's guard sees only its own evidence
A rebuttal that repeats an inadmissible value ('the 70,000원 in the community post is not verified', 'instead of KRW 45,000') fires the value pattern; the claim-support check flags such a value anyway
37: an unconditional yes/no without the 1-year condition is caught by the required mention, not by a pattern
Rare spellings of wrong values ('사만오천원', '30k won', '50 USD', 'within a week') are not all covered by patterns
